proposal: Single-storey rear extension to a terraced house

pages.text:
Site: 8 Heron Way, Eastmere
Dwelling: end-terrace, 2 bedrooms
Proposal: single-storey rear extension, bathroom
Parking: on-street

The extension projects 3.0 m beyond the original rear wall.
Pitched roof, eaves 2.4 m; brick to match.
Floor level raised 300 mm above existing.
